newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Nov cargo traffic up 4.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France Nov cargo traffic up 4.9 pct.

text.p: Air France recorded a 4.9 percent increase in cargo traffic in November 1996, with 428.4 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), figures from the French national carrier show.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
The overall cargo load factor was up 0.7 percent on the same month the previous year at 73.1 percent, the airline said.
In the first eight months of the current financial year - which runs from April 1 1996 to March 31 1997 - Air France transported 3.24 billion FTK, up 5.7 percent on April-November 1995.
Overall cargo load factor during April-November 1996 was stable on the same period the previous year at 68 percent, the airline added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
